messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: service=continuous-batcher region=us-west-2 severity=high — 90th latency spiking, OOM paging events on gpu-nodepool-3. Triggering paging mitigation runbook. thread=1890123456

maya (oncall): I'm on it. seeing a pile of OOM/paging logs in the runtime dashboard. marking on-call. @nick can you take runtime triage?

nick (eng-runtime): Looking. initial hypothesis: KV cache growth + large max_batch_tokens causing huge KV pages to be kept and then paged. pulling last deploy and batch config.

jiwon (sre): Observed host swap + GPU memory eviction across nodes 3/8. Page fault rates jump correlated with request surge at 13:12:10 UTC. Persistent connection latencies at 3-5s.

nick (eng-runtime): Here's current batch config from Canary (copied):
```
continuous_batching:
  enabled: true
  max_batch_tokens: 20000
  max_num_seqs: 256
  max_wait_ms: 250
  kv_cache_retention_secs: 3600
  kv_cache_max_pages: 50000
```
Looks wrong — max_batch_tokens definitely high for typical seq len distribution.

maya (oncall): Who changed that? diffing config now. @devops-bot show last config deploy commit.

devops-bot: deploy-7892 by paul — updated default batching profile to match LLM-Proto-XL tests. Files changed: infra/batching/profiles/proto-xl.yml

paul (product): That was a prod test tweak to reduce error rates in scoring flows. Didn't expect it to land in default profile. Sorry — rolling back if that's the cause.

eli (cust-succ): Heads up — two customers reported degraded response times (payment-api and notesync). ticket links: <https://support/reports/INC-2241>, <https://support/reports/INC-2242>. Are we looking at customer impact?

jiwon (sre): Impact: 12% of requests to continuous-batcher saw >2s tail latency during spike window, downstream timeouts in some clients. No 5xx surge on public API yet, but internal retrypath increased.

nick (eng-runtime): Quick mitigation plan: 1) rollback max_batch_tokens to 4000 and max_num_seqs to 64 2) reduce kv_cache_max_pages to 5000 3) trigger kv cache eviction on affected pools 4) rolling restart of batch shards in us-west-2 with 1 pod at a time

maya (oncall): Agree. Do we have a safe command to change live config without full deploy?

nick (eng-runtime): Yes, we can patch the runtime config via config-api. Command: 
```bash
curl -X PATCH https://config.internal/api/v1/services/continuous-batcher -H 'Authorization: Bearer $CONFIG_TOKEN' \
  -d '{"continuous_batching.max_batch_tokens":4000,"continuous_batching.max_num_seqs":64,"continuous_batching.kv_cache_max_pages":5000}'
```
This will take effect on next config refresh (~15s).

maya (oncall): I'll run that now. Patch and then watch metrics.

maya (oncall): (runs command) patch applied — response 200. config version bumped to 2026-11-54. metrics window open. @nick @jiwon please monitor memory and paging.

jiwon (sre): Early signs good — page faults dropping within 30s on nodepool-3. GPU memory stable at previous baseline. tail latency sliding down to normal ranges.

nick (eng-runtime): Initiating targeted kv cache eviction for hot keys on pool-3: 
```bash
# instruct runtime to evict pages > 100MB
POST /internal/kvcache/evict?threshold_mb=100 -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN" 
```
Triggered.

eli (cust-succ): Notifying customers: Sent interim update to payment-api and notesync that we have mitigation in place and are monitoring. will follow up with RCA after containment.

paul (product): Confirmed rollback of the profile in infra repo. prepping explicit guardrail so Proto-XL test profile won't become default.

maya (oncall): Next step: rolling restart of 4 shards. Doing 1 shard at a time with healthcheck 30s. Starting shard-2.

devops-bot: deploy rolling/restart shard-2 done (ok). shard-3 queued.

jiwon (sre): shard-2 looks healthy post-restart. no paging, latency stable. continuing.

nick (eng-runtime): After patch, we still saw a small retry storm due to client timeouts. recommend increasing request timeout on ingress for 60s -> 90s as temporary safety net for long-running requests to give retries room to settle.

maya (oncall): Do we want to enable temporary traffic routing to dedicated pool for heavy customers?

paul (product): Yes for payment-api we have contract SLOs — we can route their API key to dedicated capacity until full RCA. Paul will coordinate with sales/legal if needed.

eli (cust-succ): Payment-api prefers dedicated routing. Initiating ticket and notifying their ops.

maya (oncall): All shards rolled, metrics stable for 7 min. paging events fell to zero. marking incident as mitigated. still keeping channel open for RCA.

incident-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE: status=mitigated — service=continuous-batcher region=us-west-2 mitigation=live-config-rollback,kv-evict,rolling-restart. started=1890123456, mitigated=1890123790.

jiwon (sre): Preliminary impact summary for timeline: 13:11-13:18 UTC — elevated paging and tail latency, ~12% requests >2s, two customer tickets opened, no data corruption, no 5xx surge.

nick (eng-runtime): Root cause: misapplied Proto-XL batching profile with overly large max_batch_tokens and max_num_seqs that pushed KV cache page count and retention beyond safe limits, overwhelming GPU memory working set and causing host-level paging. Failure mode amplified by long kv_cache_retention_secs.

paul (product): Action items I'll own: 1) remove Proto-XL from default bundle and add explicit opt-in 2) add deploy-time guard that prevents profiles with max_batch_tokens > 8000 becoming default 3) coordinate customer comms for payment-api and notesync.

nick (eng-runtime): Action items I'll own: 1) add runtime validation in config-api to cap values 2) add perf regression test for kv cache growth on PRs 3) write automation to safely evict oversized pages on config change.

jiwon (sre): Action items I'll own: 1) add alert for kv_cache_pages > 10k with paging-rate context 2) improve runbook to include instant traffic-shed steps 3) add correlation dashboard for batch config vs paging metrics.

eli (cust-succ): I'll follow up with postmortem draft and customer impact notes for support.

maya (oncall): Thanks all. moving to post-incident review tomorrow 09:30 PT. will close channel after RCA created. final note: effective hotfix was live-config rollback + kv eviction + rolling restarts. keep an eye on us-east regions for similar accidental deploys.

paul (product): adding PR constraints and tagging infra owners to review.

incident-bot: INCIDENT CLOSED: final_state=mitigated, closure_ts=1890124022, severity=high, notes=\"KV cache growth from misconfig; mitigated by rollback + eviction + restart. customer impact: degraded latency for ~7m for subset of traffic, two support tickets opened.\"
